buildings.name: Wood Generator

buildings.description: A quarry that produces stone over time.

buildings.description: A farm that produces food over time.

buildings.description: A mining operation that extracts iron ore from the earth.

buildings.description: A large storage facility that increases resource capacity.

buildings.description: A gathering place that attracts wanderers. Each tavern increases wanderer spawn chance by 3% per day.

buildings.description: Provides shelter for your population. Each house increases population cap by 10.

buildings.description: An improved training ground with advanced equipment. Unlocks Advanced Training (100 XP/day).

buildings.name: Combat Arena (Elite)
buildings.description: An elite training facility for intensive combat drills. Unlocks Intensive Training (200 XP/day).
